title: the lance charge - the riders strike home
audit_comment: THE LANCE CHARGE - the R189 feeder goes live. The three lances (light, medium, heavy horse - the chart rows 24-26) join the weapon registry riding the pinned R189 cells (the weights and dice), the one printed arms price (6 g.p., the equipcosts row) shared by all three; the combat Actor carries the mount field and toActor copies it; the rider's round-one lance strike doubles its damage (the chart asterisk). The p.38 weapon-vs-AC chart lists no lance - the zero adjustment row is the no-adjustment JUDGMENT (the R145 audit rows extended). The R158 speed ladder names no lance - the speed rides the unknown default, contract-side. The spear set-to-receive needs a charging FOE - no monster charge concept exists; the R189 double-asterisk pin stays contract-side

banner.title: THE LANCE CHARGE - the R189 feeder goes live, the three lances ride the registry
banner.provenance: The mount arc reaches its first combat fold: R776 seated the rider, R777 sold the horse, R778 put the company in the saddle - and now the lance lands. The three lances (light, medium, heavy horse) join the engine registry as items (the R314 deep-crossbow pattern), every cell riding the already-pinned R189 chart rows 24-26 (the 50/100/150 gold-piece weights, the S/M dice 1-6/2-7/3-9, the L dice 1-8/2-12/3-18) and the one printed PHB arms price (6 g.p., shared by all three kinds). The combat Actor gains mountKind (toActor copies it), and resolveMelee doubles the rider's round-one lance damage - the engine has no charge command, so the round-one strike reads as the charge, the mount covering the closing ground (the JUDGMENT, the R232 surprise-as-from-behind pattern). Honest boundaries: the p.38 chart carries no lance row (zero adjustment, the R145 audit extended), the R158 speed ladder names no lance (unknown default), and the spear set-to-receive needs a charging FOE - contract-side. Every touched TU (items, actor, party, state_combat via the battery build) is compile-gated
banner.sentinel: Zero new book pages: the dice, weights and price ride the already-pinned R189 chart and the R300/R308 equipcosts row
